problem: With the security module disabled, guardOutput returns ALLOW_DECISION with no findings, so the prompt-injection refusal never fires; injection text is imported verbatim with no reason and no security object, while the docs and help say it is refused in every security mode.
impact: A project set up with --no-security imports instruction-override text as an active reviewer, indistinguishable from a clean pass.
suggested_fix: Run the deterministic injection detector for imports regardless of the module and document the disabled-module behaviour.
evidence: CLI probe in a temp project with modules.security absent: status imported, SKILL.md contains the text, exit 0; advisory/enforced probes refused it.

sites: src/gdskills/import-skills.ts gateText (callers planOne, planUpdate, decideRule, overwriteImportedSkill)

verification.evidence: re-ran the temp-project probe with modules.security absent against commit 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: injection overlay is refused, exit 1, nothing written; no longer reproduces.

disposition.evidence: fixed in 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: import runs the deterministic injection detector with the security module off, so the disabled-module import is refused, exit 1, nothing written

problem: decideReferencedRules is fed every non-deprecated source, including refused packages, so rules cited by a refused package are still written.
impact: A refused overlay still adds rule files to .metaproject/rules.
suggested_fix: Exclude refused sources from rule collection or report their rules as skipped.
evidence: Probe: skills [[review-bad, refused]], rules [[house/clean.mdc, imported]], file written.

verification.evidence: re-ran the refused-package-plus-rule probe against commit 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: house/clean.mdc is reported 'skipped — cited only by a refused package' and not written; no longer reproduces.

disposition.evidence: fixed in 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: rules cited only by a refused package are skipped, not written

problem: Refused rows exit 0; a SKILL.md blocked under enforced mode used to throw (non-zero) and now exits 0.
impact: A CI bootstrap passes while installing nothing.
suggested_fix: Exit non-zero when a real run has any refused row.

verification.evidence: re-ran the refused-rows probe against commit 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: real run with refused rows exits 1, dry run exits 0, also under enforced; no longer reproduces.

problem: createProjectSkill writes scaffold, registry and catalog (and overwrites on --force/update) before the final re-gate.
impact: A late refusal leaves a header-only SKILL.md and registry entry, or destroys an installed skill on update/--force.
suggested_fix: Gate the final stamped text before createProjectSkill.
evidence: Mutation M4 forcing this path: 3 tests fail on a leftover scaffold.

verification.evidence: re-ran the late-refusal, --force and skills update probes against commit 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: a refusal writes no scaffold or registry entry and the installed SKILL.md stays byte-identical; no longer reproduces.

disposition.evidence: fixed in 967e7020, contained in PR #822 head 42201489: the final stamped SKILL.md is gated before scaffold, registry and catalog, so a refusal writes nothing and --force and skills update leave the installed skill unchanged
